source_pages: Bathroom Collection (price list April 2026) printed p.85 / PDF 87 whole; p.86 / PDF 88 held back (see extraction_note)
extraction_note: 2026-10-14, 7612 Hillside Dr bathrooms. PILOT BA60987 checked in a test model by Andriy (2026-10-14: 'all fine', after the core 1.9.29 Apply fix); the rest of printed p.85 generated the same way: four types, 26 codes, d.47 (BA6) and d.62 (BA4). NOT held: printed p.86 'Base unit with drawers - 1 jumbo drawer, 1 shaped drawer' suffix 86 (10 codes) - it prints ONE elevation pair, 28 / 28, where every other two-front position prints a handle pair and a gola pair; which one it is cannot be read off the page. Ask Elda.
family_naming_note: Namespaced 'Bath ...' because the registry merges section files by family NAME and the Kitchen System already holds 'H.58.5' (base_h58_5.json). The Bathroom Collection's own letters: BA6 = d.47, BA4 = d.62 (printed p.85, p.90). Section names carry '| Bathroom Collection' because the catalog map keys sections by name and the Kitchen System prints a 'Base units H. 58.5' of its own.

data.mounting_note: The bathroom Maxima units are wall-hung by nature: every arrangement (printed p.188-194) hangs them, the general features (printed p.32) show the wall-hung fixing, and the sections print no plinth. The hanging height is a PROJECT decision - 7612: worktop top 890 (35 in), carcass bottom 890 - 20 - 585 = 285 (Andriy 2026-10-14).

door_versions.note: 58,5 full, 55,5 gola on the single-front positions - the same 30 mm the kitchen families print.
